headline: Sensex plunges 989 points as bears take control of Indian stock markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex tumbled 989 points and Nifty slipped below 25,650 as bears tightened their grip on the market.
Drag in IT stocks and HDFC Bank pushed the benchmark indices lower.
The Indian Rupee nosedived 60 paise to settle at 92.98 against the U.S. dollar.
Nomura raised its expectation for the RBI's December rate hike to 50 bps.
whatHappening: Sensex plunged 989 points on November 27, reversing gains from the previous session.
The Rupee saw a steep decline of 60 paise to settle at 92.98 per U.S. dollar.
Nomura revised its December RBI interest rate hike forecast to 50 bps, while BoB maintained its 25 bps prediction.
Consumer-durable loans saw a 22% surge during Diwali, with 58% of borrowing demand coming from rural India.
summary: Indian stock markets faced severe selling pressure on November 27, with the Sensex plunging 989 points and Nifty slipping below 25,650. The decline was heavily led by drags in IT stocks and HDFC Bank alongside a sharp fall in the Rupee to 92.98 against the US dollar. Additionally, Nomura raised its forecast for an RBI December rate hike to 50 bps.
